name: Investigation Data 18
definition: Provides the detailed information for the investigation response.

OriginalInvestigationSequence.name: Original Investigation Sequence
OriginalInvestigationSequence.definition: Original investigation sequence as provided in the investigation request.

OriginalInvestigationReason.name: Original Investigation Reason
OriginalInvestigationReason.definition: Original investigation reason as provided in the investigation request.

OriginalInvestigationReasonSubType.name: Original Investigation Reason Sub Type
OriginalInvestigationReasonSubType.definition: Original investigation reason sub type as provided in the investigation request.

ResponseData.name: Response Data
ResponseData.definition: Response to the investigation, as provided by the responder.

RelatedInvestigationData.name: Related Investigation Data
RelatedInvestigationData.definition: Additional information that will be sent seperately to the message such as a copy of a passport.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the message.||Usage: The use of the EnclosedFile element must be bilaterally agreed.

RelatedFileData.name: Related File Data
RelatedFileData.definition: Details of a document not enclosed in the message that will be sent or made available seperately.

ResponseOriginator.name: Response Originator
ResponseOriginator.definition: Identification of the agent or party who has originated the response.||Usage: The element should only be provided when different from the Responder.

InvestigationDataGuideline.definition: InvestigationData should only be repeated when the original investigation request contained multiple occurences of the InvestigationData block.
